pages.text: Lesson learned the expensive way. Processes cooled by $(fluid)Superfluid Helium$() hand it back as $(fluid)Warm Helium$(). Recondense it in a $(item)Bose-Einstein Condenser$() or the $(item)Fractionation Spire$() - or you will run out. Below about 2 K helium flows with no friction at all; a little warmer and it is just a cold liquid.

High-tier processes leave $(fluid)Dimensional Residue$(). The $(item)Fractionation Spire$() splits it into Dark Matter, Exotic Matter, Inflaton Field and Chronon Gas. Nothing is waste if you can separate it.

$(item)Spacetime Slag$() can be sorted by a $(item)Maxwell's Demon$() for Void Lattice and, rarely, Planck Shards. Maxwell dreamed up his demon in 1867: a tiny doorkeeper sorting fast molecules from slow, seeming to cheat the second law. Mine sorts rubble.
Crumpled leftover geometry. A Maxwell's demon can sort useful shards out of it.$(br2)Made in $(item)Fractionation Spire$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Bose-Einstein Condenser$(): Fractionation Spire$(li)$(item)Fractionation Spire$(): Essence Distillery$(li)$(item)Spacetime Slag$(): Coherent Wiring Harness, Planck Shard, Theoretical Notes II, Void Lattice Shard, Warm Helium
$(fluid)Superfluid Helium$(). Made in $(item)Fractionation Spire$().$(br)Used for: Abiogenesis Crucible, Annihilation Core, Anomaly Containment Ward, Anomaly Resolution Engine, Antihelium Nucleus.
$(fluid)Warm Helium$(). Made in $(item)Tokamak$().$(br)Used for: Distillate of Forces, Maxwell-Boltzmann Gas, Superfluid Helium.
$(fluid)Dimensional Residue$(). Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br)Used for: Chronon Gas, Dark Matter, Dimensional Singularity, Exotic Matter, Inflaton Field.
